content: As shown in Figure FIGREF5, during multi-task training, two different hidden features will be fed into the text encoder $enc_t$: the embedding representation $\mathbf {e}^s$ in MT task, and the $enc_s$ output $\mathbf {h^s}$ in ST task. Without any regularization, they may belong to different latent spaces. Due to the space gap, the $enc_t$ has to compromise between two tasks, limiting its performance on individual tasks.
